NXS TCS Article — Reports

IPBES TCA & Nexus assessment corpus: embeddings, keypaper similarity, topics

Author

Rainer M. Krug

Published

July 8, 2026

This is the landing page for the NXS TCS Article analysis. The corpus is built from two curated IPBES assessment Zotero groups — TCA and NXS — matched to OpenAlex works and extracted from a local snapshot. Each work is embedded with SPECTER2 (title, abstract, and title+abstract variants) and scored by cosine similarity against a curated set of TCA/Nexus keypaper concept definitions. The corpus is then clustered with BERTopic.

The analysis is split across three reports, described below. Each opens in the output/reports/ folder alongside this page; a link resolves once that report has been rendered (targets::tar_make()).

Embedding Report

Embedding quality control: corpus coverage (title / abstract presence and counts), language mix, input text length and silent truncation at the 512-token limit, work-type counts, title vs abstract variant agreement, and embedding-norm sanity checks. Read this to judge whether the embeddings are trustworthy before interpreting the analysis.

Chapter Analysis Report

The main analysis: how close the papers in each assessment / chapter are to the keypaper concepts. Overall chapter alignment (median similarity with bootstrap 95% CIs), which chapters are really different (Cliff’s δ), the chapter × keypaper heatmap, and an interactive per-keypaper top-matches browser with matches stacked by assessment / chapter. Also includes corpus-wide keypaper-relevance (score distributions, score vs year / citations / work type) and keypaper-set diagnostics (coherence, per-keypaper distribution).

Topic Modelling Reports

BERTopic clustering of the corpus (UMAP + HDBSCAN) and how the keypaper concepts distribute across the discovered topics. One report per BERTopic config; the config name is shown in front of each link.

  • runpod_v5_supervised — Topic Modelling Report — active (feeds the viz layer)
  • runpod_v6_chapters — Topic Modelling Report
